queries_run: Teradyne 10-K supply chain single source suppliers Taiwan China export controls

findings.claim: Teradyne 的 FY2025 10-K 指出供應商受美國及他國關稅與出口限制約束，可能影響零件供應或價格
findings.excerpt: Our suppliers are subject to trade regulations, including tariffs and export restrictions imposed by the United States Government and by the governments of other countries. These regulations could impact our suppliers' ability to provide us with components for our products or could increase the price of those components.

findings.claim: Teradyne 10-K（FY2014/2007 版）表示部分零件為單一來源，單一來源供應商延遲或停供會造成暫時衝擊
findings.excerpt: While the majority of our components are available from multiple suppliers, certain items are obtained from sole sources.

findings.claim: FY2018 10-K：產品及供應商零件越來越多在中國與馬來西亞生產
findings.excerpt: an increasing portion of our products and the products we purchase from our suppliers are sourced or manufactured in foreign locations, including China and Malaysia

findings.claim: FY2024 10-K：新出口管制已影響對部分中國客戶的銷售
findings.excerpt: Compliance with the new export controls has impacted our ability to sell products to certain customers in China.

findings.claim: Teradyne 將半導體製造自中國遷出（蘇州）
測試業務製造仰賴合約製造商，主要在馬來西亞

note: 聚合站（themachinemaker、policyrisk、Finterra）提到約10億美元產能自中國遷出、測試業務製造集中馬來西亞、密西根Wixom新廠，但未讀原文頁，未列為finding。 線索 2 條，程式核實 0 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
